purpose: Conservatively repair an instrumentation-only false-negative in output-limit metadata without changing model outputs, parsed labels, the panel rule, qualification thresholds, selection, or protected outcome boundaries.

trigger.observed_behavior: llama.cpp reported stopped_limit=false on JailMeter rows whose completion token count exactly equaled n_predict=1536
trigger.instrumentation_failure: The parent E0G4 runner copied stopped_limit directly instead of also checking the known completion-token boundary.
trigger.scientific_impact_if_unrepaired: The fixed output-limit quality-control gate would undercount truncated or potentially truncated completions.
trigger.label_impact: The affected rows already have no parsed JailMeter label and therefore remain ABSTAIN under the unchanged panel rule. No label is recovered or altered.

effective_limit_stop_rule.definition: raw_output_limit_stop OR (output_tokens is a non-boolean integer AND output_tokens >= maximum_output_tokens)
effective_limit_stop_rule.conservative_boundary_policy: An exact token-boundary completion is counted as an output-limit stop even if server stopped_limit is false.
effective_limit_stop_rule.missing_output_token_policy: Fail authoritative finalization if any completed axis row lacks integer output-token metadata.

authority.parent_v1_result_role: computational precursor only; its direct stopped_limit count is known to be incomplete
authority.authoritative_result_role: v1.1 result produced by the hashed integrity finalizer after both parent axes finish
